from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        shared = operator.SharedMemory(
            worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, num_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.MAGIC_SQUARE_SHARED_EQUATIONS_PROMPT, prompt_custom.MAGIC_SQUARE_SHARED_FILL_PROMPT, prompt_custom.MAGIC_SQUARE_SHARED_AUDIT_PROMPT],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.MAGIC_SQUARE_SHARED_AGGREGATOR_PROMPT,
        )
        draft = await shared(problem)
        finalizer = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.MAGIC_SQUARE_FINAL_VERIFY_PROMPT, prompt_custom.MAGIC_SQUARE_FINAL_FORMAT_PROMPT],
        )
        solution = await finalizer(f"Puzzle:\n{problem}\n\nCandidate draft:\n{draft['response']}")
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

Puzzle:
{problem}

Shared document so far:
{document}

Agent: {agent_id}
Round: {round}

Your role:
- Extract the givens by position.
- Write row/column/diagonal equations for the unknown cells.
- Derive the common magic sum if possible from any completed line.
- If another contributor made an arithmetic mistake, explicitly correct it.
- Do not invent unsupported values.
- Pay special attention to the rule: do not place any already-given filled number into a different cell.

Write concise notes and equations only. Do not output the final grid unless it is fully justified."""
